correctness.rationale: Every p-morphism from the full nonempty powerset P_X under reverse inclusion maps maximal singleton worlds to maximal singleton worlds, defining unique c:X->Y. For every A, monotonicity gives c[A] subset F(A); lifting every singleton {y} subset F(A) yields B subset A with F(B)={y}, then an x in B forces y=c(x), proving equality. Conversely A intersect c^{-1}[T] is nonempty and maps onto every nonempty T subset c[A]; no choice or finiteness hypothesis is used. Identity/composition, m^n hom-counts and m!Stirling(n,m) onto counts follow exactly. Independently enumerated all 826113 arbitrary world maps for n,m in 1..3 and found precisely 56 p-morphisms, all induced by c. The finite enumeration is only corroboration of the written unrestricted-set proof.
